agent_feedback.analysis: The MSKU table stores information about special customer-specific stock. It is used to track stock at the plant level, including special stock indicators, valuations, and physical inventory statuses. The table does not have any foreign key relationships with other tables. Common use cases include inventory management, stock valuation, and quality control.
